tree-sitter grammars (packages/analyzer/grammars/*.wasm)

The WebAssembly grammars that Weft's analyzer loads are compiled from these projects, each under
the MIT License (versions and checksums: docs/languages.md):

- tree-sitter-python.wasm: tree-sitter-python 0.25.0, https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-python
    Copyright (c) 2016 Max Brunsfeld
- tree-sitter-c.wasm: tree-sitter-c 0.24.1, https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-c
    Copyright (c) 2014 Max Brunsfeld
- tree-sitter-cpp.wasm: tree-sitter-cpp 0.23.4, https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-cpp
    Copyright (c) 2014 Max Brunsfeld
- tree-sitter-swift.wasm: tree-sitter-swift 0.7.3, https://github.com/alex-pinkus/tree-sitter-swift
    Copyright (c) 2021 alex-pinkus
- tree-sitter-c_sharp.wasm: tree-sitter-c-sharp 0.23.5, https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-c-sharp
    Copyright (c) 2014-2023 Max Brunsfeld, Damien Guard, Amaan Qureshi, and contributors.
- tree-sitter-ruby.wasm: tree-sitter-ruby 0.23.1, https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-ruby
    Copyright (c) 2016 Rob Rix
- tree-sitter-php.wasm: tree-sitter-php 0.24.2, https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php
    Copyright (c) 2017 Josh Vera, GitHub
    Copyright (c) 2019 Max Brunsfeld, Amaan Qureshi, Christian Frøystad, Caleb White
- tree-sitter-go.wasm: tree-sitter-go 0.25.0, https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-go
    Copyright (c) 2014 Max Brunsfeld
- tree-sitter-rust.wasm: tree-sitter-rust 0.24.0, https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-rust
    Copyright (c) 2017 Maxim Sokolov
- tree-sitter-java.wasm: tree-sitter-java 0.23.5, https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-java
    Copyright (c) 2017 Ayman Nadeem
- tree-sitter-kotlin.wasm: @tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-kotlin 1.1.0, https://github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-kotlin
    Copyright (c) 2024 Amaan Qureshi <amaanq12@gmail.com>
